in_sanskrit.name: राजन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Rajan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘राजन्’ (rājan), which means ‘ruler, king’. The prefix ‘रा’ (rā) in the name signifies ‘ruler’ or ‘king’, while the suffix ‘न्’ (n) denotes the present participle form of the word. This name has its origins in the ancient Indian civilization and has been in use since the Vedic period.

in_hindi.name: राजन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Rajan is transliterated as ‘राजन’ in Hindi, which is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘राजन्’ (rājan). The name ‘राजन’ in Hindi is pronounced as ‘rājan’ and means ‘ruler, king’.

in_tamil.name: ராஜன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Rajan is transliterated as ‘ராஜன்’ in Tamil. The meaning of the name Rajan in Tamil is ‘one who understands the science of ruling’ or ‘one who knows the art of ruling’. The name has its roots in the ancient Indian culture and has been in use for centuries.

in_telugu.name: రాజన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Rajan is transliterated as ‘రాజన్’ in Telugu, which is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘राजन्’ (rājan). The name ‘రాజన్’ in Telugu is pronounced as ‘rājan’ and means ‘ruler, king’.
